correctness.rationale: For positive label i write r=i+1. In fg'-gf' a first nonzero term of g of exponent s<=p-r must satisfy s=r, since otherwise (s-r)f_r g_s is nonzero below degree p. After subtracting a multiple of f, all exponents are >=p-r+1, giving exactly the claimed centralizer. The locus in g_i^2 of rank <=1 on the interval of coefficient columns i+1 through p-1-i is the product of an affine space and an irreducible rank-one cone. The leading-nonzero stratum is dense in it and agrees with the cited positive-label stratum, so these are global reduced equations. For label zero the unit centralizer is one-dimensional (differentiate g/f); the unit locus is dense in the irreducible nilpotent cone, and scaling in either coordinate yields all dependent pairs of nilpotents. Intersecting with g_b^2 cuts off low columns, and projection of the surviving rank condition to any intermediate label preserves rank <=1. This gives the stated geometry, dimensions and path. The count of nonzero rank-one matrices follows by choosing their column line in F_q^2 and then a nonzero d-vector of coefficients; 'row-space' in the frozen proof is a terminology slip only. At label zero, when f(0)=0, triangularity shows p-nilpotency iff the linear coefficient vanishes. For f(0) nonzero, D^p is a scalar times D; the top coefficient enters that scalar with coefficient (p-1)! f(0)^(p-2), as only the top derivative term followed by p-1 constant derivative terms contributes a top-coefficient summand to D^p(x)(0). The resulting nilpotent count is q^(p-1), and scaling the nonzero dependent pairs gives the same point-count expression at (0,0). These arguments use equations and constructions over the prime field and count all extension-field points, not just prime-field checks.
residual_risks: The statement and proof concern reduced varieties only; they do not determine any nonreduced structure of intersections.

value.rationale: A reducible commuting variety is not understood solely by listing its components. The uniform global rank conditions give a usable model of how these components glue, produce a codimension-one path rather than just a component count, and provide exact simultaneous-intersection counts useful even when several strata contribute. These are natural structural invariants of the family, not an arbitrary finite slice.
residual_risks: The value assessment does not extend to scheme-theoretic or singularity invariants that were not determined.
